decisions.decision: Approvals enters the bottom bar with its count at every width, not only from 640px up
decisions.rationale: docs/08-UI-UX-SPEC.md section 3.1 caps the bar at six items AND says never to drop Approvals while something is pending. The phase's own acceptance criterion — 'Approvals appears in primary navigation with its count the moment anything is pending' — settles the contradiction in favour of the pending queue.

decisions.decision: The Insights nav slot points at /analytics until phase 15 ships
decisions.rationale: Insights supersedes analytics in phase 15. Linking the slot at a route that does not exist would break the phase's own 'no screen reachable only from a URL' criterion in the other direction.

The spec's route table names /home and /money. /expenses has been the ledger since phase 2 and carries approvals, recurring, close and settle beneath it. Renaming the family would break every link a Home has already shared and every bookmark, and buys nothing a redirect does not.

decisions.decision: Announcement severity is text with a check constraint, not an enum
decisions.rationale: Matches the schema documented in docs/04-DATABASE.md section 4. Three values, and nothing in SQL branches on them.

decisions.decision: announcement_expires_in_the_future holds on UPDATE as well as INSERT
decisions.rationale: An announcement ends by expiring or by being taken down. Back-dating an expiry so it 'was never shown' is neither, and the constraint refuses it. Proved by an integration case.

decisions.decision: Today's food block asks the library recommender only, never the AI half
decisions.rationale: The AI call is a second network hop with its own latency and failure mode. Today is the screen that must not wait; the Food screen is where ideas are asked for.
